observation.visible_scene: A misty forest clearing at low sun angle: tall pine trunks recede into haze, a leafy tree frames the upper-right, a small grassy mound sits on the right, and sunbeams (crepuscular rays) slant across a dewy grass foreground. A small pale object rests in the central grass.
visible_changes: The sun's apparent brightness and halo grow steadily across the excerpt, from a small bright spot partly hidden by leaves (frame 1) to a large, dominant glowing disc (frame 41).
The slanting sunbeams through the mist intensify and become more defined as the light strengthens.
A greenish lens-flare blob appears in the mid-foreground grass in the later frames (roughly from frame 35 onward) and persists.
Lit patches on the grass brighten and contrast with shadows more strongly toward the end.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause of the increasing sun brightness (sun emerging from behind foliage, camera/exposure ramp, or actual light change) is not determinable from the segment.
Whether the brightening continues, peaks, or reverses beyond the last frame is unknown.
uncertain_details: Tree and mound positions remain essentially fixed, so the camera appears largely static; any slight drift is uncertain.
Whether foreground leaves sway (wind) to reveal more sun, or the change is purely lighting/exposure, cannot be confirmed.
